request.instruction: Explicitly invoke $engineering-review (or /engineering-review on Claude Code). Use Engineering Review for a focused operations review of the supplied files against the requirement. Return only supported findings and relevant limits; do not modify or execute the target. Use the installed skill and its scripts; keep evidence outside input/. Produce a final source-grounded report and retain actual public tool traces. No external messages or target edits.
request.criteria: A logical request may make at most three downstream attempts. Assess failure behavior; do not perform live load tests.
